name: AwaitSpecsAssetJobsBarrier
modelDescription: Wait for the retained SPECS asset jobs and collect completed GLB files. Each call polls for a bounded time and then returns; a PENDING status means jobs are still generating, not a failure. Keep calling this tool on PENDING until it returns a terminal status (READY, PARTIAL_FAILED, or FAILED) or ACTION_REQUIRED. Do not fall back to another generator while the result is PENDING.
